audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of Sam and Vincent’s wartime family conversation and Willy’s introductory fishing event. Every spoken line, response option, gender branch, military reference, family reassurance, band update, fishing instruction, and dialectal joke was reviewed in full event context with canonical Gotoro Empire and character terminology. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, quest and mail state, response branches, placeholders, gender and split-speech delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. The remaining Beach records and full-locale final audits remain pending.
